channel.title: KR8TIV Field Notes
channel.description: Practical design and marketing guides from KR8TIV in Edmonton, Alberta.

item.title: How to design remarkable signage with AI—without building an expensive mistake
item.description: A practical guide to AI-assisted sign design, current display technology, Edmonton permits and the decisions that turn a strong concept into a buildable sign.

item.title: How to use AI to design a storefront layout that works beyond the render
item.description: Explore stronger retail layouts with AI while keeping dimensions, accessibility, stock handling and approvals grounded in the real premises.

item.title: How to use AI for vehicle wraps that look good on the actual vehicle
item.description: Turn a wrap concept into a readable mobile identity, with exact-vehicle checks, supplier-approved files and honest measurement instead of invented impression counts.

item.title: How to create a business blog that earns search traffic and useful enquiries
item.description: Turn real customer questions into useful blog posts for Edmonton and Alberta. Learn topic selection, Google AI-search basics, cadence, and lead tracking.

item.title: How to run local advertising that brings better enquiries in Edmonton
item.description: Plan local ads for Edmonton and Alberta with honest budgets, better targeting, useful video, and qualified-lead tracking. Build a test before spending more.

item.title: How to build a marketing campaign that brings in customers in Edmonton
item.description: Build an Edmonton marketing campaign around a clear offer, useful creative, and qualified enquiries. Includes a worked example and a first-month plan.

item.title: How to design packaging that stands out—and still works when it is printed
item.description: A packaging design workflow for Edmonton and Canadian brands: earn attention without losing the product, the required information or the practical job of the pack.

item.title: How to attract customers with signage they can actually use
item.description: Build a sign system around recognition, the offer and the entrance—then test it from the places customers actually see it.

item.title: How to design an amazing storefront sign in Edmonton
item.description: Plan your Edmonton sign and storefront: concept design, immersive store experiences and project management across Alberta and Canada. Pricing and scope explained.

item.title: When does a custom website pay off for an Alberta business?
item.description: Decide what your Alberta business website needs before a rebuild. Work through costs, buyer questions, local SEO, accessibility, and a safer launch plan.
